name: XForosh
author: abolfazlvalikhani

sections.description:
Don’t just see site visits; understand customer behavior.

Have you ever wondered:

  • How many people are genuinely interested in your products?
  • Where did your customers come from?
  • Which products did they view but not purchase?
  • What makes a visitor convert into a customer?
  • Which customers are ready to buy?
  • Where should you focus to increase sales?

XForosh is built to answer these questions.

XForosh is a next-generation customer relationship management tool that doesn’t just store customer data—it tracks and analyzes customer behavior on your site.

What data is collected and sent?

This plugin collects behavioral data from your site visitors and sends it to the XForosh server only after you explicitly consent to data collection during setup. No data is transmitted before consent is granted. Data sent includes:

  • Behavioral events: Page views, product views, add to cart, checkout start, completed purchases
  • Order data: Order ID, purchased products, amount, order status
  • Traffic information: Traffic source (UTM), entry page
  • Device information: Platform type, browser (brief)
  • Account information (when logged in): Name, email, phone number

No payment information (card numbers, bank passwords, etc.) is stored or transmitted.

For more information, read our:

  • Privacy Policy
  • Terms of Service

Who is this for?

XForosh is ideal for site owners who want more than just traffic—they want more sales.

Especially for:

  • Online stores (with WooCommerce support)
  • Service-based websites
  • Businesses using online advertising
  • Sites that want to understand their advertising campaign performance
  • Businesses that want to better understand their customers

Key Features

  • Revenue Source Analysis: See which traffic sources generate revenue
  • Sales Opportunity Detection: Identify products and customers with sales potential
  • Customer Behavior Analysis: Conversion funnel and drop-off points
  • Abandoned Cart Tracking: Identify incomplete shopping carts
  • Traffic Source Analysis: See where your users come from
  • Customer Journey: Track the path from first visit to purchase
  • Customer Acquisition: Understand how each customer found you

Important Notice

To use XForosh’s analytics features, a connection to an XForosh account is required. This plugin does not work standalone and connects to the XForosh server for data analysis.

Configuration

Main Settings

After installation and connecting to your XForosh account, you can adjust the following settings from the “Settings” page:

  • SDK Status: Check if the SDK is active on your site
  • User Sync: Sync WordPress users with XForosh
  • Demo Mode: Use sample data to explore features
  • Data Consent: Consent to behavioral data collection

WooCommerce

If you use WooCommerce, the plugin automatically collects cart and order-related events. No additional configuration is needed.
sections.installation:
Prerequisites

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Active account on XForosh

Steps

  1. Download the plugin from the WordPress repository or upload the zip file.
  2. Activate the plugin from the “Plugins” menu.
  3. The “XForosh” menu will appear in the WordPress admin panel.
  4. Click on the XForosh menu to see the setup wizard.
  5. Enter your XForosh account credentials or create a new account.
  6. The SDK will be installed on your site and start collecting data.
sections.faq:
What is XForosh?

XForosh is a next-generation customer relationship management and analytics system that helps you better understand your website’s customer behavior and use that information to increase sales.

Do I need CRM expertise to use XForosh?

No. XForosh is designed for business owners and does not require specialized CRM or data analytics knowledge.

Is XForosh only for e-commerce?

No. Any business that wants to better understand visitor and customer behavior can use XForosh.

Is XForosh a replacement for Google Analytics?

No. XForosh has a different purpose. Web analytics tools focus on traffic and site performance; XForosh focuses on understanding customers and their behavior in the buying journey.

Do I need an account to use XForosh?

Yes. To use XForosh’s analytics features, connecting to an XForosh account is required. This plugin does not work standalone.

What data is sent to the XForosh server?

Behavioral data (such as product views, cart additions, purchases) and order information. No payment information or passwords are sent. See the Description section for details.

Is my data secure?

Yes. Communication with the XForosh server is encrypted via HTTPS. Read our Privacy Policy.

Can I use XForosh without connecting to the server?

No. XForosh is a server-based analytics system and requires connection to the XForosh server for reports and analytics.

Will my data be deleted if I remove the plugin?

Removing the plugin clears local settings. Data stored on the XForosh server is managed per our Privacy Policy.

Is XForosh free?

The XForosh WordPress plugin is free to install and use. Use of the XForosh analytics service may include various plans. Visit XForosh for more information.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Renamed plugin to XForosh for WordPress.org directory compliance
  • All data transmission now requires explicit admin consent (opt-in)
  • Migrated all inline scripts/styles to properly enqueued assets
  • Improved input sanitization
  • Scoped checkout event deduplication per visitor

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • WordPress to XForosh integration
  • User event collection
  • WooCommerce support
  • Customer analytics dashboard
  • Revenue and traffic source analysis
  • Sales opportunity detection
  • Abandoned cart tracking
  • Customer Journey and acquisition path
